title: New title screen for my voxel colony builder
author: cody-fifth-door

comments.author: EdgarDruin
comments.body: Ah, CubesCape!  Make the first letters of each word slightly taller and odd brains like mine won't read exactly the wrong words, or differential the colors a bit more.  Looks interesting though!

comments.author: EchoingAngel
comments.body: I love it! I have my game (factory builder) spawn a little factory as the Start Screen background and the game's character is lounging randomly somewhere in the room watching it. It was meant to be a bit of "Where's Waldo?" but he's pretty easy to notice lol

comments.author: Schumetzq
comments.body: That is awesome title screeen! But you know what I would definetly play a city builder as I see, they look really cute. Imagine building with title screen style so cool!

comments.author: CycleMother2006
comments.body:
Very cool.

Do note that the platforms disappear before the little builders actually walk off of them, so they're walking across air after the construction completes for several moments until they get back to a ladder.
